suite: the DAG zoom, Fit and the grid header
expect_red: [real] a zoom scales the DAG alone: the grid's rows and header keep their own size, and every leader still runs from its dot to its row's seam

mutations.contract: A leader's node end is the scaled dot.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_leader_starts_at_the_mark_it_names_on_every_tier (2026-10-30). Leaders computed as if the DAG were at 1: the node ends miss their dots at any other zoom.
